title: Tries
definition: A trie (prefix tree) is a tree-like structure used to store and search keys in a dataset of strings.
intuition: Nodes share common prefixes to optimize prefix lookup and memory.
how_it_works: Each node contains children characters and a boolean marker denoting word completion.
when_not_to_use: When character set is huge and sparse (high memory cost).
common_mistakes: Not updating the word ending marker
complexity: Search/Insert: O(L) where L is string length
